title: Ee Pattanathil Bhootham
desc: An evil magician releases a friendly spirit and orders him to make money through crime. However, the spirit falls into the hands of circus children after the sorcerer loses him in an accident.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.

title: Thuruppugulan
desc: Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.

title: Surya: The Soldier
desc: An orphan raised by his deceased mother's friend, dreams of joining the army. Later, he must leave the love of his life behind when he receives his appointment letter.

title: Naduvan
desc: After learning that his wife is cheating on him with his business partner, an enraged Karthik plans to kill her. Only when he decides to execute his plan, thieves break into their house to rob them.
